components.name: Follow on Instagram
components.description: Square-edged follow link; the wide large-text treatment reflows to a lighter small-screen variant.
components.html: Follow on Instagram
components.css: .ds-follow-instagram{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:30px;padding:0 22px;min-height:50px;border:2px solid var(--ink, #0b0a0d);background:#d34718;color:#080708;text-decoration:none;text-transform:uppercase;font:max(24px,calc(30 * var(--u, 1px)))/1 var(--display, "Six Caps", "Arial Narrow", sans-serif);letter-spacing:.065em;transition:filter .2s}.ds-follow-instagram span{transform:scaleX(1.55);transform-origin:left;-webkit-text-stroke:.5px}.ds-follow-instagram svg{width:30px;height:30px;flex-shrink:0;fill:none;stroke:currentColor;stroke-width:1.6;stroke-linecap:round;stroke-linejoin:round}.ds-follow-instagram .ds-arrow{margin-left:auto}.ds-follow-instagram .ds-play{fill:#d34718}.ds-follow-instagram:hover{filter:brightness(1.18)}.ds-follow-instagram:focus-visible{outline:3px solid currentColor;outline-offset:5px}@media(max-width:1279px){.ds-follow-instagram{min-height:54px;padding:0 14px;gap:12px;background:#df642f;color:var(--ink, #0b0a0d);font:500 19px/1.2 "Barlow Condensed","Arial Narrow",sans-serif;letter-spacing:.015em}.ds-follow-instagram span{transform:none;-webkit-text-stroke:0}.ds-follow-instagram svg{width:24px;height:24px}.ds-follow-instagram .ds-play{fill:#df642f}}@media(max-width:700px){.ds-follow-instagram{min-height:52px;padding-inline:18px;font-size:21px}}@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.ds-follow-instagram{transition:none}}

components.name: Build-note disclosure
components.description: Native details/summary framed by fine paper rules, with an inline plus that rotates when open.
components.html:
Read the build notes

Sound, onboarding, animation, feedback and final art still need work. Bad Haunts is in development; there’s no announced release date yet.
components.css: .ds-notes{background:var(--paper, #ead8c0);color:var(--ink, #0b0a0d);border-block:1px solid #ae8263;font:16px/1.6 var(--body,"Courier Prime",monospace);max-width:65ch}.ds-notes summary{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:16px;min-height:56px;padding:12px 0;font-weight:700;list-style:none;cursor:pointer}.ds-notes summary::-webkit-details-marker{display:none}.ds-notes summary svg{width:24px;height:24px;flex-shrink:0;fill:none;stroke:currentColor;stroke-width:1.6;stroke-linecap:round;stroke-linejoin:round}.ds-notes[open] summary svg{transform:rotate(45deg)}.ds-notes summary:hover{text-decoration:underline;text-underline-offset:.2em}.ds-notes summary:focus-visible{outline:3px solid currentColor;outline-offset:5px}.ds-notes-body{padding-bottom:22px}.ds-notes-body p{margin:0}

narrative.overview:
Midnight Prompt Book pairs cream paper with black script stock: condensed display lettering, typewritten notes, ruled controls, and authored pencil marks. Orange Human cues and violet Haunt replies give opposing voices a shared visual grammar.

The material is flat and tactile, not a cinematic gaming backdrop. Preserve the recognizable Mons Games and Bad Haunts assets. Responsive clarity and accessibility take precedence over exact lettering and pixel placement; local textures and type carry the identity when the wide composition reflows.
keyCharacteristics: Opposing paper tones with orange and violet role accents.
Narrow display type, readable typewritten copy, handwritten annotations.
Flat page materials, rules, tape tabs, and semantic controls.

rules.name: Opposing Voices
rules.body: Use orange for Human cues and violet for Haunt replies; neutral paper and ink carry essential reading.

rules.name: Three Voices
rules.body: Condensed type announces, typewritten copy explains, and handwriting annotates. Keep these roles distinct.

rules.name: Flat Stock
rules.body: Create separation with paper tone, rules, and tape, not elevated card shadows.

dos: Do preserve the cream/black split and orange/violet role distinction.
Do use the supplied logos and locally served font and texture assets.
Do keep narrow layouts in normal document flow and retain readable body copy.
Do retain visible focus, native control semantics, and reduced-motion behavior.
Do keep desktop follow labels at least 24px; the dark lettering on saturated desktop fills depends on large-text treatment.
donts: Don't replace the prompt-book material with a generic cinematic gaming hero.
Don't introduce rounded card grids or floating shadow surfaces into this flat page system.
Don't use handwritten notes for essential long-form copy or control labels.
Don't hide mechanics behind the cue interaction; highlighting connects information already visible.
Don't preserve desktop coordinates at the expense of responsive clarity or accessibility.
